balanced_attention_cnn_v2_raw.pt.description: Attention model (BalancedAttnCNN) retrained from scratch, 17 epochs, L4 GPU, BN running stats NOT recalibrated (still corrupted by EuroSATDSFullAug's heavy augmentation).
balanced_attention_cnn_v2_raw.pt.note: Not the model to evaluate or deploy -- kept only as the pre-recalibration reference point (train() vs eval() mode diagnostic in attn_v2_result.json used this checkpoint's weights).

balanced_attention_cnn_v2_recalibrated.p.description: Same weights as _raw.pt, BatchNorm running stats recalibrated via recalibrate_bn() on clean training data (12s, weights frozen).
balanced_attention_cnn_v2_recalibrated.p.note: This is the model to use for any further eval/deployment of the v2 retrain.
